findings.title: Empty map removes all question-linked diagrams
findings.problem: The populated pairs registry is replaced with an empty object, deleting every existing diagram association and its question-specific parameters. Updating the review index does not restore these associations.
findings.failure_scenario: Question 12 previously resolved to the potassium diagram with k=6.8; pairs['12'] now returns undefined. The same happens for every formerly mapped question, leaving the question-linked diagram feature with no registered items.
findings.fix: Regenerate the map from the approved question and diagram sources, retaining the supported associations and parameters, and emit the required signed artifact instead of an empty registry.

assessment: Request changes: the change removes every existing question-to-diagram binding. The replacement signatures and sourceKey bindings could not be validated from the two supplied files.
